theseus_29g_budget.assumptions: Starts from the XA25 (a wired 25 g mouse) and swaps its interior USB cable for a battery. Radio parts (antenna, RF passives, PMIC + 2 buck inductors), a USB-C receptacle and the battery bay/fixing are NOT included (masses not sourced), so these totals are lower bounds.

theseus_29g_budget.reading: Built like the XA25, a 29 g wireless mouse can carry at most ~4.9 g of battery before any radio hardware, i.e. a ~140 mAh-class pack (~17-18 h at an 8 kHz load, ~79 h at 1 kHz). Fitting a 250 mAh pack (SLX capacity) at 29 g needs ~2.6 g out of the shell, buttons or PCBs (e.g. shell + skates 12.2 -> ~9.6 g). The titanium-screw swap (11 x 0.064 g -> 11 x 0.02 g) saves only ~0.5 g.
